notes: Initial numerical-zero assumption was incorrect:the actual silent Opus decoder publishes a tiny finite numerical floor. Final controls retain exact sample counts and bound every float sample to absolute1e-25;old production tests are unchanged.
The source frontier uses independent normalized float32 PCM because the public concat output is float32 WAVE,not source signed16 storage. Final byte oracle verifies every nonzero front sample.
The6-byte active encoded limit also permits one float32 output sample,while the later9-byte packet remains excluded only by the selected temporal window.
